elevenlabs.note: Owner (Nov 9): always «Aran - Parsi», eleven_v4, no fallback voice; ~300k credits/month for this channel. Owner's FIXED VOICE RULE (Nov 12): stability 0.50, similarity 0.75, speed 1.0, best format (pcm_44100 / mp3_44100_192); then ONE speed-up of the whole file with a factor computed every time = duration / (words / 2.96), max 1.33 (never 1.4); long pauses trimmed first if needed; WAV until one final AAC 192k; music 0.30 with sidechain ducking, SFX 0.2-0.4, loudnorm -15/-1.5, 2.5 s music fade-out.

openai.instructions: Language: Persian (Farsi), standard Tehrani accent, natural modern spoken Persian - pronounce every Persian word correctly, read numbers in Persian. Voice: an energetic, captivating storyteller explaining money like a top Persian finance YouTuber talking to a friend. Tone: confident, curious, a little dramatic and warm. Pace: brisk and lively, never slow or sleepy; short pauses only right before a reveal or after a question. Emphasis: punch the key numbers and the twist words. Never monotone, never salesy.

pace.note: Owner (Nov 12) approved by ear: raw ElevenLabs (speed 1.0) -> long pauses trimmed if needed -> ONE atempo. Rubberband sounded like a hall.
